notes: This contract records the portable acceptance conditions for a timestamped update-rate reduction scenario. It is an interoperability test contract, not a provider implementation claim: a provider must receive an adapter-supplied FOM containing one reliable and one best-effort attribute plus a positive named update rate.

requirements.condition: The active named subscription resolves the adapter-supplied positive update-rate designator, while the active default subscription reports the no-reduction boundary for its attribute.
A timestamped update containing reliable and best-effort attributes delivers both attributes on the first passel and delivers the reliable attribute on the next passel.
requirements.evidence: reflectAttributeValues(time) payload, producer, tag, order, transportation, logical-time, and retraction metadata

requirements.condition: The named-rate best-effort subscription suppresses an excess best-effort-only passel while the recipient still crosses the requested time boundary.
requirements.evidence: stable reflection count and matching timeAdvanceGrant callback

requirements.condition: The suppressed passel's retraction handle is accepted at the terminal boundary and a second retract reports MessageCanNoLongerBeRetracted.
